abstract: A correct diagnosis reached from insufficient or misleading evidence can pose a clinical hazard, yet outcome-based accuracy may reward such lucky guesses. abstract: Modern neural predictors can model highly nonlinear maps, but many scientific and engineering tasks require reasoning in the opposite direction: given a performance or safety level, the goal is to characterize the preimage, that is, the complete set of inputs which meet the desired target level and optimize over that set.
